result.title: Integral Multipliers and Arithmetic Obstructions for Two-Hidden-Layer ReLU Maxima
result.summary: We study exact representations of maximum functions by ReLU networks with two hidden layers and integer parameters. The least positive output multiplier is two for the six-input maximum, and either two or six for the seven-input maximum. We obtain these bounds from integral cubical fillings and a coefficient-preserving passage from polytope identities to networks. For the coordinate-facet complex of the six-simplex, we compute a coning index of six over the integers and three after inverting two, allowing arbitrary integral directions within each facet. A class in the homology of the unrestricted kernel complex characterizes the remaining seven-input problem; its vanishing is equivalent to an integral filling of a fixed target. We also construct a finite character that separates rational from three-local representability in a dictionary containing two known constructions and all pairs of edge-disjoint three-edge forests. This obstruction permits nonsymmetric coefficients and is confined to the specified dictionary. Control of lower-dimensional remainders yields a sufficient criterion in the top-dimensional quotient. Exact certificates and verification programs accompany the finite calculations.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究用整数参数、两层隐藏层的 ReLU 网络精确表示最大值函数，给出六输入与七输入 max 的最小正整数输出倍数界，并借助整立方填充、同调障碍与有限构造证书刻画七输入问题的剩余困难。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其关于 ReLU 网络精确表示能力与不可绕过障碍的结论，可能可供核查「内部状态能否精确承载某类比较/选择型函数」这一表示容量问题，联系较远且未涉及推理动态。
